name: Photoquip India Limited
about: Photoquip India Limited trades in digital studio flashlights and photographic accessories in India. It provides digital lights for cinematography, videography, and photography as well as its accessories. The company offers its products under the Nanlite, Nanlux, Kupo, Comica, Gutek, PortKeys, and Problitz brand names. It also exports its products. Photoquip India Limited was founded in 1959 and is based in Mumbai, India.
